title: StudioBrain Provider File
description: How to talk to a generation backend. Drop *.provider.yaml in _Providers/ (project) or templates/Providers/ (catalog). Unknown backends are a second tiny file — no new Rust crate.

wire.description: process = desktop/LAN CLI (Blender, UVR). Cloud workers must 501 process and localhost base_url. dashscope = Alibaba DashScope native API, which is NOT openai-compatible; its compatible-mode endpoint (/compatible-mode/v1) can instead be used with wire: openai-compat.

provides.description: Kebab-case capability tags (e.g. llm-chat, tts, voice-clone, image-gen, video-gen, music-gen, 3d-gen, audio-stems, media-convert). Capability matching (workflow step substitution) and marketplace filtering consume this.

client_direct.description: Curated knowledge that a browser may call this provider directly (CORS). Absent means unknown — the designed default for providers that do not publish a CORS policy.

models.description: Where the app pulls the provider's live model list, and the cache interval.

pricing.description: Dynamic price feed or static per-model table. Prefer a real endpoint; static tables rot.

billing.description: byok = user's own key, unmetered; brainbits = our preset key, metered. Local/device providers omit the field (free when it is the user's device or the user's key).

chat.description: Chat-routing hints so ai-sdk's hardcoded KNOWN_PROVIDERS table can be codegen'd from the catalog. Values mirror ProviderRecord in the ai-sdk provider registry.

nativeChatPath.description: Native chat path, e.g. chat/completions or v1/messages.

modelPrefixes.description: Model-id prefixes used for provider inference, e.g. [gpt-, claude-].

slots.description: What this backend accepts and emits. Workflow edges only connect matching modalities.

requires.description: Runtime requirements. 'wire: process' and localhost base_url imply platforms containing 'desktop'; auth.env should be mirrored in requires.env.

base_url.description: Empty/omitted means the platform default (AI Gateway / local model-manager).

auth.description: header/scheme/env describe key auth. scheme 'oauth2' is RESERVED (SBAI-7619): authorize_url / token_url / scopes / client_name may be declared, but no OAuth flow is implemented this cycle and no catalog provider uses it yet.

headers.description: Static headers sent with every request, e.g. {"anthropic-version": "2023-06-01"}. Auth headers belong in the auth block, not here.
